title: Chase and Yonas cognitive enhancement patent
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Chase and Yonas cognitive enhancement patent, about c. 2020 at Lockheed Martin, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Enter Lockheed Martin engineers Charles Chase and Gerald Yonas with a patent called cognitive [music] enhancement using feedback.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that two engineers at Lockheed Martin, a large American weapons and aerospace company, named Charles Chase and Gerald Yonas, filed a patent called "cognitive enhancement using feedback", which he places around 2020. He brings it up in an episode about a UFO book that he says the Pentagon tried to censor. He tells it as a sign that defence engineers were working on ways to boost the human mind.
